courses.title: Lower-Division Major Req
courses.choice_note: [3] Lower-Division Major Req - 7 semester credit hours beyond Core Curriculum - AHTC 1100, (DANC 1310 or DANC 1305), 3 semester credit hours from a DANC studio, and 3 semester credit hours from a DANC, THEA, or MUSI studio ensemble course. NOTE: If the student took DANC 1310 or DANC 1305 as their core, then the student may choose any free elective in its place as a lower-level major requirement.
